run_shard_docs: run the shard_docs script to split a large document file into N shards respecting document boundaries
run_shard_docs_with_num_shards: run shard_docs with --num-shards flag to split input file into the specified number of output shards
review_main: review the main function that parses input file and num-shards arguments to split documents into shards
review_output_doc: review the output_doc nested function that writes a document to the correct shard file with proper spacing
refactor_shard_docs: refactor shard_docs to support custom document boundary delimiters instead of empty lines
